title: The Mists Remain
summary: Strahd von Zarovich still rules his valley, and the mists close behind you for good.

epilogue.title: Barovia
epilogue.text: The mists close around Barovia like a fist. Somewhere beyond them, other travellers are already on the road.

epilogue.title: The Count's Guests
epilogue.text: You live out your days in the valley as the count's guests. Every year his invitations to dinner grow harder to refuse.

epilogue.title: The Fallen Heroes
epilogue.text: Those of you who fell in the castle walk its halls still. They answer to a new name, and they do not remember the sun.

epilogue.title: Ireena Kolyana
epilogue.text: Ireena becomes the lady of the castle after all. On clear nights the villagers see her at a high window, and they look away.

epilogue.title: Ireena Kolyana
epilogue.text: Krezk's wall keeps Ireena safe for one more winter. Then the black carriage stops at the gate one night, and the gate opens.

epilogue.title: Ireena Kolyana
epilogue.text: Ireena hides, and runs, and hides again. The valley is very small, and the one hunting her is very patient.

epilogue.title: Ismark
epilogue.text: Ismark keeps his father's chair and his father's fear of the castle. He does what a burgomaster can, which in Barovia is not much.

epilogue.title: The House on the Corner
epilogue.text: At least the old house at the village's edge is quiet. Rose and Thorn sleep, whatever else becomes of Barovia.

epilogue.title: The House on the Corner
epilogue.text: The old house at the village's edge has learned to wait. Its door still swings open for strangers on foggy nights.

epilogue.title: Vallaki
epilogue.text: Vallaki holds a festival every week, and every week the castle's shadow is exactly as long.

epilogue.title: Vallaki
epilogue.text: Lady Wachter rules Vallaki in the castle's name. Her neighbours learn to smile when she passes, and to say nothing at all.

epilogue.title: Vallaki
epilogue.text: Vallaki's council meets by candlelight and bars the gates at dusk. It is the best anyone can do in that castle's shadow.

epilogue.title: Vallaki
epilogue.text: Vallaki keeps its palisade and its nervous festivals, and tells itself it is safe.

epilogue.title: The Wizard of Wines
epilogue.text: Wine still flows from the Martikov vineyard, and the castle takes its share. The family's ravens watch, and remember, and wait.

epilogue.title: The Keepers of the Feather
epilogue.text: The Keepers of the Feather keep their secret and their watch. They have waited a long time already; they can wait longer.

epilogue.title: Krezk
epilogue.text: The Abbot's bride stands among the castle's servants now, still waiting to be loved.

epilogue.title: Krezk
epilogue.text: Krezk keeps its wall high and its gate barred. Its people pray to the White Sun and try not to look up at the castle.

epilogue.title: Ilya Krezkov
epilogue.text: Ilya Krezkov lives, which in Krezk counts as a miracle. His mother keeps him indoors after dark, always.

epilogue.title: Argynvostholt
epilogue.text: The beacon of Argynvostholt still burns on its hill, the one light in Barovia the castle cannot put out.

epilogue.title: Argynvostholt
epilogue.text: The knights who rode on the castle did not ride back. Their armour stands in its halls now, polished, like trophies.

epilogue.title: Argynvostholt
epilogue.text: Vladimir's knights keep their grudge and their watch on the castle road. Their hate has outlived everything else about them.

epilogue.title: The Amber Temple
epilogue.text: The Amber Temple stays sealed. Whatever else the castle wants, it will not find a second bargain there.

epilogue.title: The Gifts You Took
epilogue.text: The gifts you took from the amber are patient. In Barovia, they have all the time in the world.

epilogue.title: Kasimir Velikov
epilogue.text: Kasimir bought his sister's life with his years, and Patrina walked up to the castle anyway. He spends his last year at its gate.

epilogue.title: Kasimir Velikov
epilogue.text: Kasimir made his peace with his sister's ghost. With the mists still closed, it is the only peace he finds.

epilogue.title: Rudolph van Richten
epilogue.text: Van Richten and Ezmerelda keep hunting in the valley, together now. They are very good at it, and it is not enough.

epilogue.title: Rudolph van Richten
epilogue.text: Van Richten goes back to his tower on the lake and his long list of the dead. Your names are not on it yet.

epilogue.title: Ezmerelda d'Avenir
epilogue.text: Ezmerelda keeps hunting alone, one wagon against a whole valley. The Vistani say she is either very brave or very stubborn.

epilogue.title: Mordenkainen
epilogue.text: Mordenkainen leaves his mountain to study the mists from inside. He says he will find the door. He has said that before.

epilogue.title: The Werewolves
epilogue.text: Emil's pack refuses the castle's call, and the hills are a little safer for it. Every full moon, the castle asks again.

epilogue.title: The Werewolves
epilogue.text: Kiril's pack hunts for the castle, and hunts well. The roads are emptier every year.

epilogue.title: Berez
epilogue.text: Baba Lysaga still squats in the ruins of Berez, waiting for a word of thanks from the child she raised. It never comes.

epilogue.title: Old Bonegrinder
epilogue.when: flag.bonegrinder_fate == bargain or flag.bonegrinder_fate == abandoned or flag.bonegrinder_fate == bella
epilogue.text: The mill on the hill keeps baking. In a valley with no way out, business is always good.
